intro: If you're after a place in town in Sing Buri with spacious rooms, a comfy bed, strong water pressure and parking — Golden Dragon Resort is a name guests keep scoring high. It's a 3-star, 80-room resort-style hotel in Ton Pho subdistrict on Bang Rachan Tat Mai Road, near the Chao Phraya River. The Superior rooms run around 28 sqm, the breakfast gets praised in reviews, and rates start at about ฿580/night. body.html: What earns Golden Dragon Resort high marks in Sing Buri is getting the basics right, consistently. The Superior rooms run around 28 sqm, bigger than a typical in-town hotel room, with comfy beds, cold air-con, strong water pressure in the bathroom, and a minibar and Wi-Fi in the room. Many guests say the room feels good value for five or six hundred baht the moment they walk in.

The thing reviews mention most is the breakfast. There's plenty of variety, it starts early, and a lot of guests say it's better than the room price would suggest. Combined with friendly, smiling staff, the overall feel is warmer than many hotels at the same price.

The location is in Mueang Sing Buri, Ton Pho subdistrict, on Bang Rachan Tat Mai Road. It's about a 3-minute drive to the Chao Phraya River and roughly 6 minutes to Wat Phikun Thong. There are markets, restaurants and food shops easy to find nearby. For self-drivers, easy parking is another point reviews like — you can park without circling for a spot.
"Bigger room than I expected, comfy bed, strong water pressure, cold air-con, a big tasty breakfast and good staff — genuinely good value for the price."

To be straight, the reviews flag two main downsides. The first is noise from the ground-floor restaurant on some nights. There's a restaurant on site and sometimes functions or evening diners, so guests in rooms above or near that part may hear it. If you're a light sleeper, ask for a room away from the restaurant at check-in.

The second is inconsistent cleaning in some rooms. Most rooms are clean on arrival, but a few reviews mention stray hair or bits of debris left on the floor or in the bathroom. Another thing some guests don't love is the rain shower mounted straight overhead with no way to angle it, which can feel awkward if you're used to a handheld shower. Check the room on arrival and ask to switch if it's not right.

Overall, Golden Dragon Resort scores 9.1 out of 10 on Trip.com from around 43 real reviews. It's a solid in-town resort for anyone who wants a big room, a good breakfast and easy parking on a modest budget, near the Chao Phraya River and the town centre. Rates start around ฿580 and rise with the season and room type into the low thousands. If you can live with restaurant noise on some nights and cleaning that depends on the room, it offers good value for the price.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Golden Dragon Resort Sing Buri

faq.q: Where is Golden Dragon Resort in Sing Buri, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Golden Dragon Resort is at 71 Moo 11, Bang Rachan Tat Mai Road, Ton Pho, Mueang Sing Buri. It's in town, about a 3-minute drive to the Chao Phraya River and roughly 6 minutes to Wat Phikun Thong, with markets and restaurants easy to find nearby.

faq.q: How much does Golden Dragon Resort cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿580/night for a Superior room. Choices include Superior Single, Superior Double and Superior Twin, all around 28 sqm. Prices rise with the season and room type into the low thousands — always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Golden Dragon Resort have breakfast and parking?
faq.a: Yes to both. There's a varied breakfast and easy parking. The breakfast is one of the most-praised points in real reviews, with many guests saying it's better than the room price would suggest, and parking is easy, which suits self-drivers.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at Golden Dragon Resort — are they clean?
faq.a: The Superior rooms are spacious at around 28 sqm, with comfy beds, strong water pressure and cold air-con. However, cleaning isn't consistent across every room — a few reviews mention stray hair or debris. Check the floor and bathroom on arrival and ask to switch if it's not right.

faq.q: Who is Golden Dragon Resort best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for self-drivers who want a big room, a good breakfast and easy parking on a modest budget, in the centre of Sing Buri near the Chao Phraya River. It works well for both family trips and travellers who want an in-town base.

During the day it's fairly quiet and peaceful, but the ground-floor restaurant can be heard from rooms on some nights, especially when there's a function on. If you're a light sleeper, ask for a room away from the restaurant at check-in.
